_about: Draft values moved out of PLAN.md in revision 0.14 (no new values except where marked). Proposed for decision 9; test 40 recomputes every derived number from the vehicle parameter files and refuses a typed one. Grok splits this into public/sensor-fusion/loop-spec/<region>.json plus contract.json when C1 ships.

loops._moved: 0.14, the loop table from PLAN.md, cells verbatim (Markdown backticks kept)

rows.Loop purposes: collision avoidance, wires and terrain, civic simulation; reports (later, until class lists and floors exist): inspection, wildlife, search and rescue
rows.Classes (first set): wire, pole, tree, bird, person (avoid only), vehicle
rows.Latency budget: ≤ 155 ms end to end, ≥ 20 fps (frame 50 ms), p99 ≤ 50 ms
rows.Max detection age: 120 ms (actuation ≤ 35 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 200 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 5; slack 8 ms; wing-to-quad transition 4 s is its own term)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.90; person 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: quad mode: hover; wing mode: loiter on a circle of radius ≥ the turn radius, checked clear inside the wing range, then transition to quad and hover; then land if the return path is not known clear, else return
rows.Independent minimum: altitude + geofence holding mapped wire spans (the obstacle layer as data)

rows.Loop purposes: station keeping; reports (later, until class lists and floors exist): hull and pier inspection, marine wildlife
rows.Classes (first set): hull, pier, buoy, swimmer (avoid only), marine animal
rows.Max detection age: 420 ms (actuation ≤ 60 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 850 ms; dwell 2,000 ms, C 3; slack 28 ms)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.85; swimmer 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: hold station (surface only for a submerged hull and never within the swimmer stand-off; to confirm for `manta-mini-66-33`)
rows.World: minimal 2D water world with current drift in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: remote operator (the hull is unmanned) watches, takes over, stops; drills in simulation until the hull is built (`pod-projects.ts:88`)

rows.Loop purposes: ground navigation, obstacle stop; goal layer and search-and-rescue reports after decision 21
rows.Max detection age: 235 ms (actuation ≤ 50 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 450 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 4; slack 11.5 ms)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.90; person 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: stop, brake held (also on a slope)
rows.World: minimal 2D ground world with an obstacle grid in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: robot team watches, takes over, stops

rows.Loop purposes: goal targeting (approach, follow, dock, line up on a marked object), obstacle stop, risk alerts
rows.Classes (first set): dock marker, obstacle, step, door, person (avoid only)
rows.Max detection age: 235 ms (actuation ≤ 50 ms; heartbeat ≤ 450 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 4; slack 11.5 ms)
rows.Independent minimum: bumper + rangefinder + downward cliff sensor + geofence
rows.World: minimal 2D ground world with a dock marker in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: robot team watches, takes over, stops; staff get its alerts

speedEnvelope.formula: range = v*B + stop + v*A_track + max(clearance, stand-off for the class); A_track = (N + burstLen) * P with N = 5 and provisional burstLen 2

rows.row: Drone quad, unmapped, below the wire ceiling

humanRole.standOffTime: (covering sensor's measured reach - minimum detection range) / v; reach equal to the minimum range gives 0 s and refuses the human as a collision layer

air.armRule: drill completes its takeovers and re-arms; no time ceiling; the covering sensor must be present

ground.armRule: drill p95 under the stand-off time, else the speed cap is solved down from the drill

water.armRule: drill p95 under the stand-off time, else the speed cap is solved down from the drill

gate2.computeRule: runs = strata x 300 per family (air 2,100; water 1,800; ground 1,500); test 40 checks the product

cameraValues.rule: alerts only; no timing law; Gate 1 refuses a card above a hazard's time-to-alert ceiling; >= 59 scored alerts per p95; false alerts <= 0.1 per camera per hour (about 30 clear hours from >= 30 distinct clips); card max age 90 days

hazards.hazard: person in the robot's path (robot place)

perRegion.trigger: hard-case count >= 30 or 60 days since the last card, whichever first (proposed)

retrainCadence.test: test 31 reports 'late' when the trigger has passed with no new card
